Risk_Description: Nominal 125 mm embedment violates ETA-20/0541 minimum slab thickness (h_min = 161 mm > 150 mm slab)
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: Risk of anchor blow-through on bottom slab soffit or extensive concrete spalling under drilling impact
Software_Mitigation_Status: Nominal 125 mm embedment is blocked by software as physically infeasible in 150 mm slab
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: Mandatory installation of reinforced concrete plinth upstands (minimum 50 mm height) or through-bolt clamping plates before drilling

Risk_Description: Reduced 80 mm embedment alternative carries severe risk of clashing with or cutting top flexural slab rebar
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: Severing top negative moment rebar in existing slab degrades host roof flexural and shear capacity
Software_Mitigation_Status: Reduced 80 mm embedment marked conditionally feasible with rebar_clash_risk_flag = True
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: Mandatory non-destructive Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) scan and covermeter survey to locate and map rebar before coring

Risk_Description: In-situ concrete compressive strength is assumed at M20 (fck = 20 MPa) without physical core testing or NDT logs
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: Overestimation of concrete cone breakout shear capacity or baseplate bearing crushing under column reactions
Software_Mitigation_Status: INSPECTION_REQUIRED_HOLD and ASSUMED_DATA_CERTIFICATION_HOLD active in register; 0.70 cracked concrete deration applied
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: On-site NDT testing (Rebound Hammer per IS 13311 Part 2 and Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity per Part 1) with core extraction if rebound indices are erratic

Risk_Description: Diaphragm shear stiffness and load transfer from purlins to roof sheeting relies on unverified field screw installation
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: Fly-bracing lateral restraint adequacy requires stiff diaphragm support; unverified diaphragm could allow purlin roll or rafter LTB
Software_Mitigation_Status: Fly bracing status classified as CONDITIONALLY_ADEQUATE_PENDING_SITE_DIAPHRAGM_VERIFICATION; FASTENER_TORQUE_UNVERIFIED_HOLD active
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: Site inspection of sheet-to-purlin self-drilling screw frequency, edge distance, and tightening torque validation

Risk_Description: Field installation workmanship, chemical resin mixing quality, and hole cleaning cannot be verified by calculation alone
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: Anchor premature slippage, bond failure, or tension pullout during peak cyclonic wind gust
Software_Mitigation_Status: Project-specific testing protocol established (1.5x factored uplift = 27.75 kN proof load on group / 6.94 kN single anchor on 25% sample)
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: Physical on-site proof load testing using calibrated hydraulic hollow-ram pull rig witnessed and certified by Registered Structural Engineer

Risk_Description: Series spring model assumes full-depth cleat bypasses 2.0 mm purlin web flexure; empirical K_bolt = 50 kN/mm lacks analytical derivation
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: If cleat does not bypass web, system series stiffness drops from 10.72 kN/mm (86.9x) to 0.618 kN/mm (5.0x)
Software_Mitigation_Status: Software mandates 6 mm stiffened cleat plate and rejects direct attachment to purlin web
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: Fabrication drawing detailing full-depth web stiffener cleat plate welded or bolted across entire purlin web depth

Risk_Description: Standard 14 mm clearance holes in cleats allow 2 mm slip before bearing engagement if standard non-preloaded bolts are used
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: Flange lateral displacement before bracing activates, degrading LTB critical moment Mcr
Software_Mitigation_Status: Pre-tensioned HSFG M12 Grade 8.8 bolts or welded cleats made mandatory; slip capacity Vdsf=17.0 kN verified against 4.969 kN brace force (UR=0.292)
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: Use of calibrated torque wrench or direct tension indicators (DTI) during site erection with certified torque inspection logs

Risk_Description: Simplified IS 875(3) Table 8 pressure coefficients may not account for localized corner/edge vortices or roof parapet wakes
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: Localized canopy rafter overload or purlin clamp failure under micro-turbulent wind buffeting
Software_Mitigation_Status: AERODYNAMIC_UNSUPPORTED_HOLD active in register; conservative 1.10 net uplift pressure coefficient used in rafter flexure check
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: Aerodynamic assessment by wind specialist or BLWT/CFD calibration if canopy tilt exceeds 15 deg or array is within 1.5 m of roof edge

Subsystem_or_Discipline: Host Building Slab Punching Shear & Base Fixity
Risk_Description: Host building framing column punching shear and reserve flexural capacity under canopy base moments (Mz = 4.90 kNm, Pu = 33.84 kN)
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: Local slab shear distress or structural cracking around stanchion baseplates under combined gravity and moment
Software_Mitigation_Status: Complete load path verification evaluates combined direct and eccentric punching shear tau_max = 0.304 MPa <= tau_c = 1.118 MPa (UR = 0.272)
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: Host building framing review and slab bottom reinforcement verification using original structural drawings or exploratory ferro-scanning

Risk_Description: Automated calculations and drawings cannot substitute for professional engineer of record review and stamping
Engineering_and_Structural_Impact: Legal non-compliance under TNCDBR-2019 Rule 38 and building code enforcement liability
Governing_Standard_or_Code: TNCDBR-2019 Rule 38 & Annexure XVII; NBC 2016 Part 2
Software_Mitigation_Status: DRAWING_UNVERIFIED_HOLD enforces PRELIMINARY watermark and BLOCKED_AFC_LOCKED status across software and exports
Mandatory_Physical_Site_Action: Formal review, stamping, and signing of calculation package and AFC drawings by Registered Structural Engineer (RSE Grade-I/II)
